subject: Clarify EOD cutover and rollforward for SOC 2 evidence
body:
From: John Evans <john.evans@acme-corp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Audit Team <compliance@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarifying EOD cutover and rollforward for SOC 2 evidence

Marcus,

Thanks for taking this — quick question for our renewal: your SOC 2 Type II report lists a period ending 2026-12-31, and the attestation letter has a signature date of 2027-01-12. For our compliance gate we need to understand whether you consider March 1 (local) events as covered by any rollforward/bridge, or whether we need a separate bridge letter that explicitly covers 2027-03-01 through 2027-03-03.

Specifically:
- If we request event-level logs for March 1 at 00:00–02:00 PST, will those be within the audited period or outside scope?
- Do you issue bridge letters that state whether controls remained in place between the report end and a short cutover window?

If a bridge is necessary, could you also include an evidence manifest mapping logs to control objectives? We're trying to avoid back-and-forth with procurement.

Appreciate a short confirmation and any draft language we can use.

Best,
John Evans
Senior Compliance Manager, Acme Corp
[attachment: acme_evidence_inquiry.xlsx (xlsx)]

----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: John Evans <john.evans@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarifying EOD cutover and rollforward for SOC 2 evidence

Hi John,

Thanks — good questions. Short answers up front: we can provide a bridge statement for a short cutover window, and we can map requested logs to control objectives, but we need to confirm the exact log sources and the time zone cutover you expect (PST vs UTC).

To be concrete, can you confirm these two items so we can prepare the bridge language and manifest: 
1) Which control objectives you want explicitly referenced in the manifest (e.g., CC6 / system operations, CC7 / change management).
2) The precise time interval you need on March 1 (local start/end). If you want midnight-to-midnight local, state the time zone.

Once we have that, Neha will pull the log manifest and Priyom will draft a bridge letter. We generally date bridge letters to the last day of coverage they refer to and include a short paragraph confirming no material control changes in the interim.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Trust & Safety, Redwood Inference
[attachment: internal_checklist.txt (txt)]

----
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 6 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarifying EOD cutover and rollforward for SOC 2 evidence

Marcus / Priyom — looping in specifics per John's ask.

We have the following sources available for the March 1 window:
- API gateway access logs (s3://redwood-prod-logs/apigateway/yyyy=2027/mm=03/dd=01)
- Inference runtime audit trail (kv-cache events + session metadata)
- Deployment/change records (CI/CD job IDs + commit SHAs)

For control mapping, propose: CC6 -> API gateway + runtime audit trail; CC7 -> deployment records + PR approval history.

If John confirms PST midnight-to-02:00, we can produce a manifest CSV tying filenames/paths to control IDs and sample extracts for the requested interval. I can also generate a draft bridge paragraph (one paragraph, letterhead) stating: "No material modifications to the design or operating effectiveness of the controls described in the 2026 report occurred between 2026-12-31 and 2027-03-03, to the best of management's knowledge, except as noted:" and enumerate any minor routine maintenance windows.

I estimate it will take ~48 business hours to assemble the manifest and 24 hours to finalize the bridge after management review.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Manager, Compliance Programs

----
From: John Evans <john.evans@acme-corp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Audit Team <compliance@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 16:44:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Clarifying EOD cutover and rollforward for SOC 2 evidence

Thanks — PST midnight-to-02:00 on 2027-03-01 covers it. For scope, we need CC6 and CC7 mapping. Procurement would like a bridge letter that covers 2027-01-01 through 2027-03-03 (inclusive) stating no material changes; if you can date it 2027-03-03 that works for our signoff.

I'll accept a draft paragraph and the manifest CSV; we can redact if necessary. Attaching our procurement intake form for reference.

Appreciate the timeline you shared.

Best,
John
Senior Compliance Manager, Acme Corp
[attachment: acme_procurement_intake.pdf (pdf)]

----
Attachments provided by Redwood in follow-up (sent via secure link):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026-report.pdf (pdf, 4.2MB)
- evidence-manifest.csv (csv, 45KB)
- acme_bridge_letter_draft.docx (docx, 12KB)
